DECISION SUPPORT

COMPETITIVE POSITIONING

Where will LUMEN sit on the shelf?

Single-can (330 ml) prices only, to compare like for like. Missing channel listings are shown explicitly.

Sources, calculations & limitations

Blended contribution = sum of channel contribution × unit share. Contribution percentage = weighted contribution ÷ weighted net revenue. No acceptance average is inferred from a sales mix.

Price-test contributions are authoritative. Net revenue already includes channel deductions; production cost is not deducted twice. Channel economics contains illustrative prices, not a complete second price test. Small percentage differences can reflect rounded source values.

There is no German sales history. Launch investment, sales volume and marketing acquisition assumptions are needed for payback; higher unit contribution alone does not establish faster payback. Channel capacity and demand are not modelled.

Competitor pack prices are excluded because their per-pack/per-can basis is not explicitly documented. Missing listings do not imply absence from the market. All data comes from the supplied case, not a live market feed. Customer names and emails are not used.
